scope: 50 current extracted TXT bodies; other complement batch 2, indices 00–49; not full historical articles or independent studies
semantic_review: Delegated agent read all 50 current TXT; root read both complete reports, checked all physical hashes/ranges and the stew source. No full HTML/image/media/comment or linked-destination reading claimed.
known_report_correction: Frozen report 00–24 omitted acerola comparison: source09 lines26/38 state 1/4 cucharadita versus 1/4 cucharada. Original report remains unchanged; separate critical record carries the discrepancy.
limits: Titles and translations are not independent clinical evidence.
Current text extraction completeness is not historical article completeness.
Conference abstracts and menus are not lectures, handouts or recipes with missing measures reconstructed.
References were read as references, not as external primary studies.
Infant formula quantities remain in critical private source records, not adult low-carb adaptations.
